links.outcome: Cross-institutional recall variability of LLM diagnosis across three hospitals
links.effect: Cross-institutional validation demonstrated stable recall generalisability, with recall coefficients of variation ranging from 0.7% to 5.0%.
links.quote: Cross-institutional validation demonstrated stable recall generalisability, with recall coefficients of variation ranging from 0.7% to 5.0%.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of LLM diagnostic behaviour to input mode and prompt formulation
links.effect: Input mode and prompt formulation produced model-specific shifts in diagnostic behaviour across with-option and without-option modes.
links.quote: Input mode and prompt formulation also produced model-specific shifts in diagnostic behaviour.

screen.reason: Multicenter retrospective evaluation of four commercial LLMs for interpreting spine radiology reports across different input modes and prompt variations without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
